close_reason: resolved by JMAP-0c9: pre-check fetch hoisted outside loop
description: Same root as JMAP-4ii.10 (correctness). The efficiency dimension: a batch create of m direct chats calls get_objects m times. Even if a single fetch were taken before the loop, the full O(n) scan per create is unavoidable at the handler layer. The backend trait has no find_direct_chat(contact_id) operation, so this is a MailBackend trait gap as well as a handler bug. The handler fix (single pre-loop fetch) is separate from the trait fix (add an indexed lookup).
title: Chat/set direct-chat dedup: O(n*m) get_objects per create (efficiency companion)
